# tests/fixtures instructions

## Purpose
Hold future small non-sensitive examples with declared expected behaviour.

## Inputs
Handcrafted transaction/customer/reference records for specific tests.

## Outputs
Clearly labelled fixture records and expected evidence descriptions.

## Functionality
Represent normal activity and narrowly scoped suspicious patterns with stable IDs, explicit currencies/times and known observation intervals.

## Constraints
A handcrafted fixture is not IBM data. Do not invent external intelligence without marking it fixture-only. Keep bulk/binary fixture artifacts out of Git.
